title: Signal: Cookie set with SameSite=None in javascript — review required
scope: Single-line match on sameSite: "none" in javascript.
limitations: Lexical: matches a literal sameSite option on one line; option objects assembled elsewhere are out of scope.

examples.line: # verified: res.cookie("sid", token, { sameSite: "lax", httpOnly: true })

fpNotes: Cookies for a documented cross-site flow with Secure set are the accepted, reviewed exception.
